g.text: SH-H/I/S/E -> local ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source and native gates OPEN

text.tspan: still-allocator
PSTATE still chain owns physical blocks; charged and
deferred words are distinct; pending allocation
reservation must settle before seal
c-closure
Native RC code holds Scheme proc; relocation root and
executable allocation lifetime are separate; no
assumption that proc is still
tcl-client
Tcl holds RC client data plus still vector; callback
result string has separate Tcl release_string
lifetime; failed creation needs qualified ownership
evidence
foreign-release
Foreign wrapper release clears callback/pointer before
invocation; collector frees wrapper without
propagating returned error; new asynchronous duty
requires explicit settlement
exit-and-census
Old cleanup frees still chain then native RC headers;
live census enumerates current processors only; VM
arena must join scan and capacity census
close-and-seal
Close native writers and allocation; drain raw borrows
and accepted operations; exact whole arena membership,
generation and GC epoch; roots and release lane
admitted
atomic-authority
Publish destination storage/RC membership, accounting
delta, release duty and exact receipt together; source
cleanup loses authority at same commit
unknown-outcome
Precommit source retains custody; postcommit VM
authority retains it; unknown ack blocks reclaim, not
necessarily exit; repeated reclaim preserves monotonic
retired identities
gc-and-exit
Serialize handoff with epoch freeze; invalidate stale
seal after GC; destination scanner/census remains
after processor leaves; join is not transfer
release-and-retire
Lease/root survival differs from raw pin; destructor
owner outlives creator; drain callbacks before final
release; error or unknown retains separate task
custody without blind pointer retry
arena-handoff
Positive only when avoided copy/rebinding work exceeds
inventory, synchronization and retained-memory cost;
no claim of zero-copy across VM
capacity-and-scan
Correctness gain is structural; scanning remains
mandatory; consolidation need not improve asymptotic
GC time
compiler-service
Parallel span improves only when affinity was critical
path and independent sessions exist; unbounded leases
can erase memory benefit
